notes.title: Major Update V1.2 (2024.09.28)
notes.content:
First Major update, with the focus on a better performance overall:
-Added optimizations once again
-Fixed translations in languages: Russian, German and Hungarian
-Many, many little changes and fixes
-Please note that Slovak and Japanese languages are already done, and we're working on adding it.

notes.title: Medium Update V1.1 (2024.08.30)
notes.content:
-Added & changed jumpscares
-Added Smooth Look
-Changes to the options menu
-Fixed crucial bug with chapter 2 saves
-Lots of small changes & bug fixes

We hope you like it! From now on, we don't plan on adding more gameplay content, and will only focus on localization and bug fixes. We initially intended to reintroduce the languages today, but we're currently experiencing issues with connecting them to Steam. We'll let you know as soon as they are available again. Thanks for your understanding!

notes.title: V1.0.1 Small Hotfix & Update (2024.08.23)
notes.content:
-Fixed the floating icons appearing before the items spawn
-Fixed the crouching height not being enough in chapter 3 to go inside Emily's secret room
-Updated the Save/Load system, this may result in breaking your current saves
-Fixed bug where you could go back in the second dream
-Fixed the radio volume being too low
-Fixed missing item name titles and descriptions
-Fixed collision bugs with some walls
-Fixed that the basement door had no sound effect
-Fixed objective appearing multiple times
-Fixed that Chapter 1 Objectives didn't disappear
-Fixed bug where the cutscene wouldn't start in chapter 1 and you can get stuck at the Entrance
-Fixed bug in the Intro Cutscene
-Fixed bug where you would stuck on Black screen at starting the game
-Fixed bug where you could get stuck at the Credits scene
-Added more SFX to Cutscenes
-Added more Checkpoints
